privatePriceDrop.question: Does the price of a private company drop by 5 for no sale in the first round?
privatePriceDrop.answer: Yes. If all players pass before the entire opening packet has been sold, all items on the topmost row are reduced by 5.

advanceBids.question: Can you make advance bids?
advanceBids.answer: Yes, at face value of the item or at least 5 over any other bid.

firstSellRound.question: When can you first sell shares in a company?
firstSellRound.answer: After Train Phase 1. Shares of regional companies may never be sold.

poolLimit.question: Does the bank pool have a per-company share limit?
poolLimit.answer: 50%. Can be temporarily exceeded during the formation of a national company.

companyBuyShares.question: Can companies buy shares?
companyBuyShares.answer: Major company may buy their own, in ORs. They can also sell, but cannot buy and sell in the same turn. They may also buy one abandoned minor company per OR from the bank pool.

initialTile.question: Where can you make an initial tile lay?

tileReplacement.question: Must a tile replacement extend existing track?

stationCost.question: Cost of station markers
stationCost.answer: 0, then 20, 40, 60, 80, as noted on the company charter for the token being placed. In addition, for a ferry, 20 multiplied by the ferry's distance, and 40 per sea zone crossed.

firstStationTiming.question: When is a company's first station marker laid?
firstStationTiming.answer: For minors, when floated. Tokens for regionals start on the map.

twoStationsOneTile.question: Can one train run to two stations on the same tile?

maxRevenue.question: Must the maximum possible revenue be claimed?
maxRevenue.answer: Yes. Players are not required to point out a higher revenue total than that claimed.

forcedTrainAfford.question: When a company is forced to buy a train and cannot buy one with its own means, what train may it then buy?
forcedTrainAfford.answer: The cheapest, un-rusted train in the the Locomotive Works or the bank pool.

forcedTrainMinor.question: Must a minor company buy a train if it does not have one?
forcedTrainMinor.answer: It must buy its reserved 2+2 train in its first operating turn, unless Train Phase 4 has begun.

privateTradeCompany.question: Are private companies purchasable by share companies?

privateClosing.question: Does using a private company's special property close it?

miscellaneous.question: Miscellaneous
miscellaneous.answer: There are five types of companies in the game - Private, Minor, Regional, Major, and National. Players start by purchasing or floating the first three types. Major companies are floated by expanding a Regional company. National companies are formed by conversion of Major companies. Tiles are laid using tile points, allowing a number of tiles to be laid or upgraded in a single operating turn. Minor and Regional companies receive 3 tile points per operating round, while Regional and National companies receive 6 and 9 tile points respectively. Every company acquires track rights during the game, which gives them the right to lay or upgrade tiles in their respective track rights zones. 17 of the 45 Patronage tiles are randomly drawn at the start of the game. These tiles respresent cities on the map that will make a one-time cash payment to the company that lays the first tile in those cities.
